title: Hub program version
description: The wire projection of a Program Version (design §2, as amended by Addendum B): immutable once effective, its `hash` is a sha256 of the canonical JSON of the FULL record (lib/hub/project.js versionRecord/canonicalJson) so it can be recomputed off the published fields alone. Two shapes share this schema: the PLAIN subset put on the wire by lib/hub/routes.js's admin/desk responses (`versions[]`) and the self-serve preview at POST /api/hub-apply?preview=1 (`version`) — { version, effectiveFrom, effectiveTo, hash, terms } — for a page that only DISPLAYS terms; and the FULL shape served by GET /api/hub/:project/program/:version and the AA2 evidence bundle (`lib/hub/public.js programVersionView(v, {full:true})`), which additionally carries every other field the hash is actually taken over: `projectId`, `mint`, `rewardMint`, `rewardDecimals`, `rewardTokenProgram`, `fundingResponsibility`, `signer` and `exclusions: { rule, wallets }`. All eight are OPTIONAL on this schema (present together, or absent together — a caller that only shows terms never needs them) because a document missing any of them cannot have its hash recomputed from itself alone: a schema-valid PLAIN document is not, on its own, enough to verify (found by the BB2 docs builder, 2026-09-18 — see docs/HUB_VERIFY.md §d and §g). Editing terms never edits a version: it creates the next one, effective the next UTC day, and the version it replaces gains `effectiveTo` but keeps its own hash and stays byte-stable. Addendum B5: today this hash is server-served, so a reader can rerun the arithmetic over server-supplied inputs — that is reproducible, not independently verified, until the funding wallet's on-chain memo commitment (B5) and the repository mirror both exist for the version.

$schema.description: present when the serving route stamps it — points back at this file's served URL.

version.description: 1-based, monotonically increasing per project. The FK other entities (a batch, a receipt, a holder view) call `programVersion`.

effectiveFrom.description: UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) this version takes effect, at 00:00 UTC. A period never straddles two versions.

effectiveTo.description: set once the NEXT version supersedes this one (bookkeeping only — never part of what `hash` covers, so verifying a closed version means hashing it with effectiveTo forced back to null). Present and possibly null on the admin/desk wire shape; today's POST /api/hub-apply?preview=1 response omits this key entirely for a not-yet-created draft — treat its absence there the same as null (a found inconsistency between the two call sites, not yet reconciled).

hash.description: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON of the full version record (with effectiveTo forced to null) — verify with lib/hub/project.js verifyVersionHash or its own re-derivation from `terms` plus the project record's own fields.

terms.description: the output of lib/hub/project.js validateTerms() — every field that decides who qualifies and how much they earn. This is the object `hash` is taken over (inside the full version record).

poolDailyRaw.description: a fixed daily reward pool, raw base units of `rewardMint` (0 if the pool is instead a share of the funding wallet's own vesting unlock — see sharePct).

sharePct.description: percent of the funding wallet's OWN daily vesting unlock that funds the pool that day, when there is such a stream.

maxSharePct.description: ceiling on sharePct's effect — the share-of-unlock pool can never exceed this fraction of the day's unlock.

minDurationDays.description: shortest lock term (from the lock's own firstSeenAt) this program admits.

maxTermDays.description: term length at the top multiplier tier.

minLockRaw.description: minimum amount still locked (raw base units of the locked mint) to qualify.

maxWalletSharePct.description: per-wallet cap on the pool's share, as a percent; 0 means off.

cancelableAllowed.description: whether a lock the CREATOR can still cancel qualifies. False unless a program version says otherwise (design §4).

fundedBy.description: wallets whose own vesting unlock feeds the daily pool (defaults to the project's fundingWallet).

excludeWallets.description: Rule B: every wallet excluded as a lock's owner OR creator — always includes the funding wallet and every `fundedBy` wallet, shown here so a holder can see why a founder's own locks are excluded.

backdateCapDays.description: how far back a lock's on-chain creation time may backdate its firstSeenAt when the scanner sees it late.

backdateNotBefore.description: unix seconds — a lock's firstSeenAt is never backdated earlier than this, whatever the chain says.

payoutSchedule.description: cadence a batch is expected to be raised on (owner, 2026-09-16). `at-unlock` pays each wallet when ITS OWN lock finishes releasing; accrual itself is unaffected — only the payout cadence changes.

vesting.description: which lock SHAPES are admitted: `cliff-only` = a single release at the cliff ("no vesting"), `vesting-only` = periodic releases, `any` = either.

projectId.description: FULL shape only (see above) — the same id as the project's own URL segment, hashed as part of this record.

mint.description: FULL shape only — the project's locked-token mint, hashed as part of this record.

rewardMint.description: FULL shape only — the reward asset's mint (may differ from `mint`), hashed as part of this record.

rewardDecimals.description: FULL shape only — the reward mint's on-chain decimals, hashed as part of this record.

rewardTokenProgram.description: FULL shape only — the reward mint's owning token program (legacy or Token-2022), hashed as part of this record.

fundingResponsibility.description: FULL shape only — the wallet responsible for funding this version's payouts (today always the project's own funding wallet), hashed as part of this record.

signer.description: FULL shape only — the wallet expected to sign this version's on-chain commitment (Addendum B5), hashed as part of this record.

exclusions.description: FULL shape only — Rule B, hashed as part of this record (mirrors `terms.excludeWallets`, kept as its own hashed field rather than only implied by it).

rule.description: the exclusion rule's name — today always "B" (exclude by recipient and by creator).

wallets.description: every wallet Rule B excludes — the same list as `terms.excludeWallets`.

commitment.description: Addendum B5 (roadmap E3): present once the funding wallet's own on-chain memo committing THIS version's hash has been independently OBSERVED by the server (lib/hub/commit.js) — never on a client's say-so. Null, or the key absent entirely, means the public wording stays "the calculation is reproducible from the published inputs," never "independently verified" or "independently committed."

sig.description: the memo transaction's own signature — check it, and the memo it carries, on any explorer.

slot.description: the slot the memo transaction landed in, when the RPC reported one.

observedAt.description: unix seconds this SERVER verified the memo on-chain — not the transaction's own block time.
